name: stca
description: Apply STCA polymer rules, learn readable rules for new measured properties with source-only numerical settings, and verify rule-guided candidates.

interface.longDescription: STCA applies the original pinned Sliding Threshold Correlation Analysis to polymer repeat units. Apply frozen published Tg/EC rules; learn custom models for measured properties such as gas permeability using source-only target transforms, bounded value-scan planning and optional nested configuration selection; export exact constraints and verify host-agent proposals. Each tier reports its numerical physical cutoff and evaluation support, without silently deleting anomalies or merging H-cap collisions. Source and evaluation roles remain separate. Cross-property reuse requires an explicit transfer request and is not a universal property predictor. Original star-containing SMILES are preserved; H-cap is calculation-only. Python/RDKit execution is required.
defaultPrompt: Apply the published Tg top-20% and EC-low bottom-10% rules to this polymer candidate table, then report the same-candidate intersection and every failed condition.

Learn custom STCA rules from this measured property table using the target, units, tiers and source/evaluation roles I provide. Audit data without silent deletion, choose settings inside source only, and report physical cutoffs and evaluation support.
Export the selected frozen STCA constraints, propose repeat-unit candidates, preserve the original star-containing SMILES, and verify every proposal after H-cap/MACCS calculation.
